title: Phase E review 3 — tags spelled out

steps.headline: Tags are spelled out now — the same named chips the tag picker uses — instead of coloured dots you had to hover to read.
steps.changed: Each tag on a session shows as its own named chip under the status pill. Past three, the rest collapse into a count that names them when you rest on it. The page mark for a note is unchanged.
steps.measured: up to 3 named chips per row, then a count; row height unchanged at 47 px
steps.notice: You can read a session's tags without hovering. A session with several tags gives its folder name less room, since the chips take the width they need.
steps.risk: A long tag name eats into the folder name beside it; the folder is the one that shortens with “…”.
